title: PH boys' doubles squad scores historic win at U19 Asian Sepak Takraw tilt
summary: The Philippines recorded a historic win in the inaugural ASTAF U19 Asian Sepak Takraw Championship on Thursday, courtesy of the trio of Gab Silva, Jerald Evangelio and Julian Gamanay.
